process.title: Scope
process.text: A short call on the problem, data, constraints, and what 'done' looks like. You get a written outline — stack, risks, and a first milestone.

process.title: Build
process.text: Weekly demos, not a big reveal. Agents, APIs, and UIs land in a repo you own, with notes on why each decision was made.

process.title: Ship
process.text: Deploy, docs, and a runbook. Eval hooks where they matter. No mystery notebooks left behind.

process.title: Support
process.text: Optional retainer for the next slice — new tools, model swaps, or sitting with your team while they take the wheel.

engagements.name: Sprint
engagements.fit: A bounded system: one agent loop, one RAG copilot, one API. Fixed scope, weekly demos.

engagements.name: Part-time
engagements.fit: Embedded builder on your cadence. Architecture, shipping, and reviews without a full-time hire.

engagements.name: Contract
engagements.fit: When you need production ownership — deploys, MCP tools, and a handoff your staff can run.

contact.title: Tell me what you're trying to ship.
contact.note: I read every note. Typical reply within one business day. For a faster start, include stack, deadline, and whether this is a sprint or an ongoing seat.
